attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The corpus keeps no Mnemonius. He is the predecessor of `tikhon-of-amathus` in that see, whom the same day's listing keeps and whose life on saint.gr names him; the page gives no year. Under the picture it prints «Η αγιογραφία παρατίθεται με επιφύλαξη», a reservation about the image and not about the entry. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
